why: Q.4(b) 'Complete the following concept map' — a rotated nested-diamond map whose four outer and four middle cells carry labels set along the diagonals, and whose inner ring + centre are the blanks the student fills. The text layer scatters the rotated labels to the end of the page dump with no indication of which ring or quadrant each belongs to, so the diagram is not reconstructible from text. The blank cells mean the crop leaks no answer.
